INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Long-lived Meta Graph API access token for an Instagram Professional (Business or Creator) account. Long-lived tokens expire after ~60 days and must be refreshed before expiry — see the refresh note in library/integrations/meta-business.md. DM tools additionally require the instagram_manage_messages permission, which is Advanced Access and only granted after Meta App Review. Gitignored — never commit; store only in the fleet .env.

INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Numeric id of the Instagram Professional account this bot acts for. Not a secret, but fleet-specific — it identifies a real account, so it belongs in the fleet .env rather than a committed file.

FACEBOOK_APP_ID.description: Meta app id the access token was issued under. Required for the server's token-refresh path.

FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET.description: Meta app secret, paired with FACEBOOK_APP_ID for token refresh. A real credential — treat it exactly like the access token.
